en.name: Spinach
en.summary: Spinach is a thin-leaved green with a very large surface area for its weight, which is why it wilts so fast. Refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below it keeps 3–7 days from the day of purchase — bunched spinach at the short end, dry pre-washed leaves at the long end.
en.pantry: Spinach has no room-temperature storage life worth naming. The leaves lose water through their whole surface, and in a warm kitchen a bunch left out collapses in a few hours and is usually beyond saving by the next morning. Take it home and refrigerate it straight away; in hot weather a cool bag for the trip makes a visible difference.
en.fridge: Store spinach unwashed at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in the crisper, in a perforated bag or a box lined with kitchen paper to catch condensation, where it keeps 3–7 days. Moisture is the enemy: wet leaves go slimy and translucent within a day or two, so change the paper if it dampens. Loose bunched spinach with roots attached goes first; pre-washed dry leaves in a sealed bag last longest but collapse quickly once the bag is opened.
en.freezer: Our data gives no freezer timeline for spinach, so there is no figure to quote here. The usual method is to blanch the leaves for about a minute, chill them in iced water, squeeze out as much water as you can and freeze the balls airtight at −18 °C (0 °F), where frozen food stays safe indefinitely. Raw spinach can also be frozen loose for smoothies. What we will not do is invent a quality window that nobody has published.
en.thawing: Add frozen spinach straight to soups, curries and pasta sauces. If a recipe needs it thawed, thaw it in the fridge and squeeze the water out hard before it goes in — frozen spinach carries a surprising amount and will water down anything it is added to.
spoilage: Dark, translucent or water-soaked patches on the leaves
Slimy leaves that clump together and will not separate
A sour, muddy or faintly ammonia smell on opening the bag
Yellowing leaves, or liquid pooling in the bottom of the bag
tips: Buy spinach with dry, springy leaves and no condensation inside the bag.
Line the storage box with kitchen paper and replace it when it feels damp.
Wash only what you are about to cook; a whole washed bunch will not keep.
A huge pan of raw spinach cooks down to almost nothing — allow far more than looks sensible.

faq.q: How long does spinach last in the fridge?
faq.a: 3–7 days from the day of purchase at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Bunched spinach is at the short end, dry pre-washed leaves at the long end.

No published freezer timeline exists in our data, so we do not give one. Blanching, squeezing dry and packing airtight at −18 °C (0 °F) is the standard method, and food held at that temperature stays safe indefinitely.

faq.q: Is slimy spinach safe if you wash it?
faq.a: No. Once leaves have gone slimy the cell walls have broken down and bacteria have multiplied through them. Washing does not undo that — throw the bag away.

faq.q: Should spinach be washed before storing?
faq.a: No. Store it dry and unwashed, and rinse just before cooking. Water on the leaves is what starts the sliminess.

zh.name: 菠菜
zh.summary: 菠菜葉片薄、表面積相對於重量非常大，所以萎凋得特別快。冷藏在 4°C 以下，從購買當天算起可放 3～7 天——帶根整把的偏短，乾燥的洗淨包裝葉可到長端。
zh.pantry: 菠菜沒有值得一提的常溫保存期。葉子整片都在散失水分，放在溫暖的廚房裡幾小時就垮掉，隔天早上通常已經救不回來。買回家請立刻冷藏；天熱時用保冷袋帶回家，差別看得出來。
zh.fridge: 不清洗，裝進打洞袋或鋪了廚房紙巾的保鮮盒，放在 4°C 以下的蔬果保鮮室，可放 3～7 天。濕氣是大敵：葉子一濕，一兩天就會變得黏滑半透明，紙巾濕了就要換。帶根散裝的菠菜最先壞；乾燥的洗淨袋裝葉能放最久，但袋子一開就垮得很快。
zh.freezer: 我們的資料裡沒有菠菜的冷凍保存期限，所以這裡不給數字。一般做法是把葉子汆燙約一分鐘、冰鎮、盡量擠乾水分後搓成球狀密封放 −18°C；食品在該溫度下安全上可以無限期保存。生菠菜也可以直接散裝冷凍打成果昔。但我們不會憑空編一個沒人公布過的品質期限。
zh.thawing: 冷凍菠菜可以直接下湯、下咖哩或拌義大利麵醬。食譜若需要解凍，請放冷藏室退冰，並在下鍋前用力把水擠乾——冷凍菠菜含水量比想像中多，不擠乾會把整道菜稀釋掉。
spoilage: 葉片出現深色、半透明或像泡過水的水漬斑
葉子黏滑、糊成一團分不開
打開袋子有酸味、土味或淡淡的阿摩尼亞味
葉子泛黃，或袋底積了一灘水
tips: 挑葉片乾爽有彈性、袋內沒有水氣凝結的。
保鮮盒底部鋪廚房紙巾，摸到潮濕就換。
只洗當餐要煮的量；整把洗過的菠菜放不住。
一大鍋生菠菜炒完只剩一點點，份量要抓得比看起來合理的再多很多。

faq.q: 菠菜放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 4°C 以下冷藏，從購買當天算起 3～7 天。帶根整把的偏短，乾燥的洗淨袋裝葉可到長端。
我們的資料中沒有公布的冷凍期限，所以不給數字。標準做法是汆燙、擠乾、密封後放 −18°C，在該溫度下安全上可無限期保存。

faq.q: 菠菜變黏了洗一洗還能吃嗎？
faq.a: 不行。葉子變黏代表細胞壁已經崩解、細菌也已大量繁殖，沖洗改變不了這件事，整袋丟掉。
不要。請乾燥、不清洗地保存，料理前再沖洗。葉片上的水分正是變黏的起點。
